skipProcessChunkingCompletion.description:
In certain cases, it may be useful to directly chunk a set of files without actually adding them to the index yet.
When set to true, after chunking, automated metadata tagging and indexing will be skipped.

scanResult.description: If #skipProcessChunkingCompletion is not true, adds metadata with tag categories to source files before indexing.

vectorStore.description: If #skipProcessChunkingCompletion is not true, indexes chunked files in vector store.

lastProcessedBy.description: If #skipProcessChunkingCompletion is not true, sets the 'lastProcessedBy' field on source file to specified user.

title:
Options passed to map reduce job for chunking.
Includes chunker spec, batch size, and whether to index files on job completion.
name: Genai.SourceFile.Job.ChunkMapReduceSpec
